definition: a traveling show with rides and games
description: At a fairground a young man in a college jacket hands a young woman a giant light brown teddy bear in front of a red and white striped stall hung with more teddy prizes, and she hugs it with her mouth open in surprise. They walk on together past the metal rails under a big ferris wheel, and he lays his jacket over her shoulders while she holds the bear. She laughs into the camera holding a white ice cream cone, and he holds another. In the last shot the two of them sit side by side high up on the wheel with the bear on her lap, the whole fair spread out below them with striped tents, stalls and rides.

en.question: What is she doing at the fair?
